name: Nara
meta: Nara Park, Sanjō-dōri and the old Naramachi quarter.

must.line: Cured mackerel or salmon on pressed rice, wrapped in a persimmon leaf.
Mugwort rice cake pounded at speed in front of you, filled with red bean.
Udon hidden inside a fried tofu pouch tied up like a purse.
Vegetables pickled for months in sake lees, dark, sweet and boozy.
Nara calls itself the birthplace of refined sake. Taste five at the brewery.

items.one: Udon tucked inside a fried tofu purse
items.fits: Wed 21 lunch if the Shizuka queue is long and you want to sit down. In Naramachi, past Sarusawa Pond, about 15 minutes from Shizuka.
Wed 21 lunch if Shizuka's queue is long or it is pouring. Just south of Sarusawa Pond, under cover.

items.one: Homely Nara lunch set in an old house
items.fits: Wed 21 lunch instead of Shizuka if you would rather book. South-east of the park, a detour of about 15 minutes.

items.one: Kaiseki in the forest behind Kasuga
items.fits: Only if you make Nara a long lunch: book for about 13:00 after Kasuga Taisha, and drop Nigatsu-dō.
Wed 21 at about 14:15, right on your walk from Kasuga Taisha to Tōdai-ji. Matcha and a sweet under the trees. One guide lists it closed on Wednesdays, so check Google Maps first.

items.one: Five sake tasting at a Naramachi brewery
items.fits: Wed 21 only if you do Naramachi instead of Nigatsu-dō. Daytime only.
Wed 21 at 12:45 as you pass Kōfuku-ji, if lunch is quick. The pagoda is wrapped, but the museum is open.

items.one: Stroll garden that borrows Tōdai-ji's roof
items.fits: Wed 21 at 15:30 instead of Nigatsu-dō, five minutes west of the Nandaimon gate. Closed Tuesdays, so Wednesday is fine. Last entry about 16:00.

items.one: Moss and pond gardens, free with a passport
items.fits: Next door to Isuien, so add it on Wed 21 at about 16:00. Bring passports.

items.one: Willow pond below the Kōfuku-ji pagoda
items.fits: Wed 21 at lunch, a two minute detour off Sanjō-dōri. Also on the way into Naramachi.

items.one: Old merchant lanes south of the park
items.fits: Wed 21 if Nara finishes early, or as a swap for Nigatsu-dō: ten minutes south of Kōfuku-ji, past Sarusawa Pond.
In Naramachi, with Harushika and Mentoan. Closed Mondays, open Wednesday.

items.one: Nara linen and tea towels since 1716
items.fits: In Naramachi. Good small gifts if you do the old town.
Not on this trip's Nara afternoon. It is a separate half day, about 15 minutes by JR from Nara plus a 20 minute walk, and only works if you drop Osaka or Arashiyama.

notes: Isuien is closed Tuesdays, so Wed 21 is fine. Kōfuku-ji is only passed in the plan, so the National Treasure Museum is listed as the add-on, not the temple itself. Naramachi shops and the Kōshi-no-ie close around 17:00. Hours for Mentoan, Mizuya Chaya, Harushika and Yoshikien were not confirmed for 2026: check Google Maps the night before.
